baseline_policy.preseason_prior: 2025 full-season football performance is the primary current-team prior, adjusted for verified 2026 personnel, coaching, role and availability changes before Week 1.
baseline_policy.rolling_2026_update: 2026 football evidence gains authority progressively as valid current-season sample accumulates; no abrupt replacement of the 2025 prior.
baseline_policy.small_sample_rule: Early 2026 observations are shrunk toward the adjusted 2025 prior and may not receive arbitrary fixed authority.
baseline_policy.promotion_rule: Any 2026-vs-2025 blend, matchup coefficient, situational coefficient, defensive weight, personnel adjustment or coaching adjustment must be selected by leakage-safe historical walk-forward validation before live promotion.

primary_data_backbone.rule: Use football/event data for forecasting. Historical spread/total fields are permitted only for ATS/total backtesting and market-evaluation targets, never as football-prior features.

training_camp_and_role: Fantasy Life Utilization Report / Game Log
documented team depth-chart and beat-reporter evidence
current_evidence_sources.rule: Do not depend on nflverse injury data for 2025+ current injury status because that feed is not currently available.

rules: MATERIAL requires a verified role, availability, personnel, starter, play-caller, scheme or workload change with a plausible direct model pathway.
POSSIBLY_MATERIAL is retained and surfaced when evidence is credible but magnitude, permanence or role translation is uncertain.
CONTEXT_ONLY may inform review/explanation but receives zero numeric authority unless separately validated.
NO_CURRENT_EFFECT is preserved when evidence was reviewed but does not alter the current football state.
Training-camp and preseason observations may not be treated as regular-season production.
Uncertain evidence is unknown, not zero, and must not be silently discarded.
A materiality label does not itself create a numeric adjustment; coefficients require validation or an already-authorized deterministic availability/role rule.

validation_sources: Pro Football Reference public team defense/advanced defense pages

fantasy_dst_contract.rule: Advanced defensive and opponent information is used as predictive input but only league-scored DST categories are fantasy outputs.

fantasy_kicker_contract.rule: Fantasy kicker modeling may remain comparatively simple while kicker quality and conditions remain available to the shared game-scoring model.

shared_information_rule: Football facts and derived team/player context are canonical shared inputs. Fantasy, DST, kicker, game, prop and market-comparison engines may transform those inputs differently but may not maintain contradictory independent versions of the same football fact.

explainability_contract.rule: Reasons must be generated from model inputs/validated indicators; the UI may display them but may not invent post-hoc explanations.

implementation_sequence: 6.5A source/quarantine audit, inherited-QA repair, shared information and materiality contracts
6.5B current 2026 roster/acquisition/coaching/injury/camp resync plus adjusted team priors and defensive ratings
6.5C player-by-defense weekly matchup calibration plus DST/K fantasy support
6.5D spread/total game model upgrade using the same canonical football state
6.5F unified game/fantasy preference reason-stack and explainability
6.5G leakage-safe walk-forward calibration, ablation QA and full projection/ranking resync
6.5H integration, no-market-contamination audit, Guardrail QA and promotion decision
locked_rules: No guessed defensive, matchup, situational, personnel, coaching, injury-severity or 2025/2026 blend weights may be promoted.
One-game opponent effects adjust weekly fantasy forecasts and uncertainty; they do not permanently rewrite season-long player quality solely because of that opponent.
Football forecasts are generated before market comparison.
Sportsbook lines may be used as evaluation targets and to compute downstream edge/EV only.
Missing fields are unknown, not zero.
All new Step 6.5 outputs remain shadow-only until historical and prospective governance approves promotion.
PR #74 remains HOLD / DO NOT MERGE and Step 7 visual work remains frozen while Step 6.5 backend work is validated.
